create_confidence_sampler: create a DensePoseConfidenceBasedSampler instance with sigma_2 confidence channel and 8 samples per class
produce_index_sample: produce a sample of indices from a tensor by selecting the most confident estimates
produce_labels_and_results: produce DensePose segmentation labels and UV results with confidence values from a predictor instance
configure_search_multiplier: configure the sampler with a search_count_multiplier to limit the pool of confident estimates considered
configure_search_proportion: configure the sampler with a search_proportion to define the fraction of estimates to sample from
